cues: For very dilute solutions we use parts per million and parts per billion.
A kilogram of water is a million milligrams.
One milligram of solute in it, this tiny speck, is one part per million.
For dilute water solutions, one ppm is one milligram per litre, and one ppb is one microgram per litre.
text: For very dilute solutions we use parts per million and parts per billion. A kilogram of water is a million milligrams. One milligram of solute in it, this tiny speck, is one part per million. For dilute water solutions, one ppm is one milligram per litre, and one ppb is one microgram per litre.
